page_title: IPS 1-1 FUL | Ipswich v Fulham 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Lewis Smith didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+4' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Bernd Leno as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
90+3' Ipswich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+3' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Ipswich force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+2' The ball goes out of play and Ipswich have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) latches onto a pass, beats his marker but shoots well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
88' Substitution. Chiedozie Ogbene is replaced by Conor Chaplin (Ipswich).
87' The referee signals a substitution. Tom Cairney (Fulham) is brought on as a substitute for Andreas Pereira.
87' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Alex Iwobi and he is replaced by Harry Wilson (Fulham).
87' A substitution has been made. Sasa Lukic goes off and Harrison Reed (Fulham) comes on.

86' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Arijanet Muric shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
85' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
83' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
81' Substitution. Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Liam Delap walks off.
81' Kieran McKenna prepares a substitution. Sammie Szmodics is replaced by Jack Clarke (Ipswich).
79' Rodrigo Muniz goes off the pitch and Raul Jimenez (Fulham) comes on.
78' Lewis Smith shows a yellow card to Adama Traore (Fulham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
75' Fulham couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Arijanet Muric (Ipswich) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
75' Corner kick. Fulham will have an opportunity.
73' The current number of shots on goal is 5:3.
72' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Sander Berge (Fulham) replaces Emile Smith Rowe.
70' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) coming on for Kalvin Phillips.

69' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Ipswich are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
68' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
65' Corner kicks – 6:3.

63' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Ipswich are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
60' The corner is swung in but Ipswich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Leif Davis (Ipswich) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall. The ball is out of play and Ipswich manage to earn a corner.
58' Lewis Smith shows a yellow card to Antonee Robinson (Fulham) for a tough tackle.
58' The resulting set piece from Ipswich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

57' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Ipswich will have a chance to score from a corner.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ipswich.
55' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
54' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
52' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Leif Davis (Ipswich), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
51' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) has received a yellow card for his foul.
50' Lewis Smith blows his whistle for a foul after Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) hacks down one of his opponents.
50' The ball is cleared after Antonee Robinson (Fulham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' Ipswich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

44' Fulham slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
44' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) commits a rough challenge and Lewis Smith blows his whistle for an infringement.
41' A brilliant cross into the box finds Chiedozie Ogbene (Ipswich), who directs his header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
39' None of the Ipswich players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
38' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Ipswich force their opponents to concede a corner.
37' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) receives a yellow card for infringement.

37' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Ipswich are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

35' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Arijanet Muric. This effort really didn't trouble him.
32' 1 - 1 Adama Traore (Fulham) hits a shot towards goal after getting on the end of a cross and the goalkeeper fails to keep it out even though the ball is not struck perfectly!
31' Fulham are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.

28' Leif Davis (Ipswich) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! It's a free kick to Fulham, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
27' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Lewis Smith saw the whole situation.
25' Fulham show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The linesman signals a throw-in for Fulham.
22' Ipswich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
21' Chiedozie Ogbene (Ipswich) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
19' The corner finds Liam Delap (Ipswich) unmarked but his close-range header is poor and slips well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
18' It will be a corner kick for Ipswich.
15' 1 - 0 What a goal! Liam Delap (Ipswich) receives an accurate pass and tries his luck with a long-range shot. He unleashes a superb strike that goes inside the left post and behind the goalkeeper.
13' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

12' Adama Traore (Fulham) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
10' Fulham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
8' Fulham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
7' Adama Traore (Fulham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' A cross from a corner kick by Ipswich is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
3' Wonderful movement by Fulham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Fulham will have the kick-off.
Lewis Smith will supervise the game today.
